title: Ridgeline Installation Services Cancellation Fee and Cancellation Refund Terms
content:
These terms apply when a signed Ridgeline Installation Services agreement is cancelled outside a rescission.

## When the customer may cancel

Outside a rescission, a contract in status contracted or scheduled may be cancelled by the customer's own confirmation, recorded first as a cancellation request on the contract. Once work has started (status in progress) the customer may not cancel on a program that does not allow cancellation after the start of work.

## Cancellation fee

- The fee is the program's before-materials percentage of the contract price while the materials status is not ordered, and the program's after-materials percentage once the materials status is ordered or received; in either case it is never less than the program's minimum cancellation fee. When the applicable percentage is 0, no cancellation fee is charged at all. The percentage amount is rounded to the cent before the minimum is compared.
- When the contract's materials are supplied through a linked special order, the installation cancellation fee is computed with the before-materials percentage, and the materials themselves are cancelled or returned under the special order's own rules of Ridgeline Special Order Services.
- No cancellation fee is charged when the program waives it for delay and the customer cancels because installation has not started within the program's delay threshold days after the original installation date for reasons on Ridgeline's or the installer's side.

## Posting and refund

The fee posts as one cancellation fee line referencing the cancellation request. The refund is the net amount paid on the contract (payments less refunds) less the cancellation fee and less the measure fee paid, since a measure fee is never refunded on a contract cancellation; it is refunded to the tender of the payments with the refund reason "cancellation", and it is never below zero. When the fee exceeds what was paid, the difference remains owed.

## Worked figures (hypothetical program terms: 10 percent before materials, 50 percent after, minimum 150.00)

| Contract price | Materials status | Fee | Net paid | Measure fee paid | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2400.00 | not ordered | 240.00 | 1200.00 | 0.00 | 960.00 |
| 2400.00 | ordered | 1200.00 | 1200.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 1000.00 | not ordered | 150.00 (minimum; 10 percent is 100.00) | 500.00 | 0.00 | 350.00 |
| 2400.00 | ordered, materials through a linked special order | 240.00 | 1200.00 | 0.00 | 960.00 |

On a hypothetical program whose before-materials percentage is 0, a cancellation before materials are ordered carries no fee: with 1035.00 paid, of which a 35.00 measure fee, the refund is 1000.00.
